hypothesis: The formula family with the largest standardized current-target Top-5/Top-6 score margin is more useful on that target than an equal-family ensemble; current-state confidence may anticipate family usefulness even when rolling past hit rates have negligible persistence.

formula_policy.families: Reuse exactly the six Q141-C0 families and 25 unique Q80 features without retuning.
formula_policy.family_score: Arithmetic mean of the family's per-target standardized feature columns; same as Q141-C0.
formula_policy.standardized_margin: (fifth-largest family score minus sixth-largest family score) divided by the population standard deviation of that 40-number family score vector; if standard deviation < 1e-12, margin=0.
formula_policy.selection: Choose the family with the largest standardized margin for the current target; exact ties broken by ascending family ID.
formula_policy.warmup: No outcome-based warmup; policy is available from the first eligible target with 50 prior draws.
formula_policy.no_tuning: No threshold, lookback, family definition or margin parameter tuning is permitted.

inference.method: paired non-overlapping 20-target block sign-flip plus circular moving-block bootstrap
inference.holm_scope: Validation and Blind OOS x 3 comparators x 4 endpoints
inference.primary: Blind OOS Top-5 hit-share delta vs equal-family ensemble
inference.acceptance: Positive delta >= 0.005, Holm-adjusted p < 0.05, and 95% block-bootstrap lower bound > 0.

uniform_null.method: Exact convolution of Hypergeometric(40,k,5) per-target hits

secondary_diagnostic.name: Spearman association between pre-target standardized margin and selected-family Top-5 hits
secondary_diagnostic.interpretation: Exploratory calibration diagnostic only; cannot change the frozen policy.

leakage_controls: strict prefix only for feature construction
score and freeze all six family rankings before reading target outcome
update prefix state only after target scoring
blind OOS not used to select or tune the policy
status_rules: A null result is a valid completed experiment. No family or engine is promoted from this historical exploratory study.
limitations: Six coarse Q80-derived families only; not the full formula universe.
Historical archive is heavily exposed to prior SONAR experiments and is not virgin prospective evidence.
A large score margin is not necessarily calibrated confidence; C2 tests this hypothesis rather than assuming it.
Uniform null assumes independent uniform 5-of-40 draws.
Holm covers the registered C2 family only, not the entire Q00-Q141 project-wide search history.
